Clear, research-backed health answers for adults over 60.

Dr. Vitalis takes the questions older adults actually face and explains what the evidence says in plain language. Examples: a blood pressure reading that looks "normal" but isn't, legs that feel weaker on the stairs, a common pill with side effects nobody mentioned, a warning sign that's easy to blame on age.

What we cover:
• Blood pressure, heart health and stroke warning signs
• Kidneys, blood sugar and circulation
• Leg strength, balance and preventing falls
• Medications and supplements worth asking your doctor about
• Everyday food choices, without the hype

Every video ends with simple next steps: what to watch for, what to ask at your next appointment, and when to call right away.

Subscribe for the next one.

For educational purposes only. Not medical advice. Always talk with your own doctor before changing medications or treatment. If you think you're having a stroke or heart attack, call 911.

Health stories for adults over 65, told through one small lake town.

On Birch Lane in Minnesota, Ansel and Marion Brooks and their neighbors live through the moments that matter after 65: the 3 a.m. trip to the bathroom, the bedroom that's too cold, the flu that won't let go, the new pill on the counter, the step you didn't see.

Each episode follows one of them through an everyday situation and turns published research into plain steps: the warning signs worth a call today, a simple check you can do at home, and the questions to bring to your own doctor or pharmacist.

Topics: falls and balance, sleep, heart and stroke warning signs, bladder and bowels, eyesight, medicines, surgery and tests, and winter safety.

Ansel, Marion and the Birch Lane neighbors are fictional characters. Stories are narrated with an AI voice and the pictures are AI-generated. Nobody on this channel is a doctor, and nothing here is medical advice. Talk with your doctor before changing any medicine.
